=== Easy Peasy Algorithm Trade Generation Tests ===

✓ returns exactly 2 rows when trigger is crossed
✓ returns empty array when no trigger crossed
✓ long trigger hit first produces Open Long
✓ short trigger hit first produces Open Short
✓ long entry uses worst-case (candle HIGH)
✓ short entry uses worst-case (candle LOW)
✓ TP hit produces PT Hit note and positive net
✓ SL hit produces SL Hit note and negative net
✓ EOD Push when neither TP nor SL hit
✓ both TP and SL hit same candle → conservative SL wins
✓ short trade TP hit produces PT Hit and positive net
✓ short trade SL hit produces SL Hit and negative net
✓ timestamps are preserved from source candles
